title: helperConsumers
responsibility: Counts runtime owners and proves concrete instantiated service classes, public instance methods and per-class consumers at the selected revision.

inputs.name: helperConsumers.tree
inputs.description: The selected source tree. Reads and optional file listings describe this exact revision, rather than files from another checkout.

inputs.name: helperConsumers.units
inputs.description: Registered units and their owned source. Helpers receive distinct callable consumers; services receive distinct active runtime owner units. Types, unused imports and forwarding exports do not count.

inputs.name: serviceClasses.units
inputs.description: Selected-revision units to annotate with proven service classes and concrete consumer counts.

inputs.name: serviceClasses.facts
inputs.description: Resolved export, construction and runtime-reference facts for the selected source revision.

inputs.name: serviceClasses.lookup
inputs.description: Source declaration lookup used to follow exported classes and inheritance.

outputs.name: helperConsumers
outputs.description: Attaches distinct helper and runtime export consumers plus concrete class facts, inherited instance methods and construction sites from active owned source.
